newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY FORINT ENDS STEADY VS BASKET, UP VS DLR.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY FORINT ENDS STEADY VS BASKET, UP VS DLR.

text.p: The Hungarian forint finished steady against the central bank's dollar/mark currency basket but firmer against the dollar in routine Friday trading, dealers said.
The Hungarian unit finished at 199.30 against the dollar compared with an opening of 199.55/60.
Traders said the forint tracked the dollar/mark throughout the session and remained pinned to the central bank's resistance level (bid).
The forint floats within the National Bank of Hungary's 4.5 percent wide intervention range against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
